2.text: “Mbese umuntu yagerageza kuvugana nawe,Ntiwagira agahinda?Ariko ni nde wakwiyumanganya ngo atavuga?

3.text: Dore wigishaga benshi,Kandi wakomezaga amaboko atentebutse.

4.text: Amagambo yawe yaramiraga uwari ugiye kugwa,Kandi wakomezaga amavi asukuma.

5.text: Ariko noneho ni wowe byateye kandi urihebye,Bikugezeho nawe uhagaritse umutima.

6.text: Mbese gukomera kwawe si uko wubaha Imana?Kandi inzira zawe zigororotse si zo ziguhesha ibyiringiro?

7.text: Ibuka ndakwinginze,Ni nde wigeze kurimbuka atariho urubanza?Cyangwa hari ubwo umukiranutsi yaciriweho iteka?

8.text: Nk'uko nabyiboneye abahinga gukiranirwa bakabiba amahane,ni byo basarura.

9.text: Bicwa n'umwuka w'Imana,Kandi barimburwa no guhuha k'umuyaga w'uburakari bwayo.

10.text: Gutontoma kw'intare n'ijwi ry'intare y'inkazi birahora,N'imikaka y'imigunzu y'intare biravunagurika.

11.text: Intare ishaje yicwa no kubura umuhigo,Kandi ibyana by'intare y'ingore biratatana.

12.text: “Nuko hariho ijambo nabwiwe rwihishwa,Maze ugutwi kwanjye kwakira guhwihwisa kwaryo.

13.text: Nibwiraga mbitewe n'iyerekwa rya nijoro,Igihe abantu bashyizweyo,

14.text: Maze mfatwa n'ubwoba mpinda umushyitsi,Bituma amagufwa yanjye yose akomangana,

15.text: Maze umwuka ampita imbere,Umusatsi unyorosoka ku mutwe.

16.text: Ahagarara aho, ariko nyoberwa uko ishusho ye isa,Imbere y'amaso yanjye hari ikintu,Habaho ituze maze numva ijwi rivuga ngo

17.text: ‘Mbese umuntu upfa yarusha Imana gukiranuka?Mbese umuntu yarusha Umuremyi we kubonera?’

18.text: Dore ntabwo yiringira abagaragu bayo,N'abamarayika bayo ibabonamo amafuti,

19.text: Nkanswe bo baba mu mazu yubakishijwe urwondo,Urufatiro rwayo rukaba rushinzwe mu mukungugu,Bameneka nk'uwakandagira inyenzi.

20.text: Guhera mu gitondo ukageza nimugoroba bararimburwa,Bapfa buheriheri ntihagire ubyitaho.

21.text: Mbese umugozi w'ihema ryabo ntiwabakuwemo?Bapfa bataragira ubwenge.
